partially_supported_method_requirements: AI Scientist-v2-style experiment execution and paper writing
Human participation at creative or key decision nodes
Human scientific taste as a distinct logged prior
Delayed-value review candidate mining for TFR replay prioritization
unsupported_performance_requirements: Human collaboration improves paper quality beyond archived manuscript probes
Full Co-Pilot v3 outperforms autonomous AI Scientist-v2
Independent human attention cost is measured for prospective experiment gates
Independent expert validation that structured feedback improves paper quality

hypothesis_frontier_smoke.interpretation: AI Co-Scientist-style generate-critique-rank front-end evidence, now followed by one same-manuscript structured-feedback measurement probe; still not benchmark or independent human peer-review evidence.

clean_clone_reproducibility.claim_boundary: Candidate mining prioritizes future TFR replay cases but does not validate positive delayed-value evidence.
clean_clone_reproducibility.note: Verifies the current pushed TFR candidate-mining package at da140a845 with a shallow clean clone. This audit is narrower than earlier full package audits and focuses on the newly added delayed-value candidate-mining path.

next_evidence_milestone: Collect blind human expert ratings, rerun gate decisions on real benchmarks, and scale matched autonomous versus human-gated trajectories before upgrading from a pilot package.

paper_quality_review.blocking_diagnosis: The package is promising but reads like a lab notebook; stronger empirical support, independent evaluation, and a focused conference rewrite are required.

fairness_package.interpretation: co-pilot frontier had no valid scored continuation; autonomous completed

matched_full_manuscript_generation_probe.limitation: internal deterministic rubric; autonomous is only valid scalar metric path; not independent paper-quality proof

online_trajectory_manuscript_probe.limitation: repeated same-continuous smoke only; tiny budget, autonomous-or-tie valid benchmark aggregate, Fairness no-valid failure, and no independent human expert review

online_matched_budget_manuscript_compara.limitation: Adds repeated same-run manuscript comparators, but current valid benchmark result does not favor co-pilot and sample size is three with one no-valid task.

same_continuous_paper_quality_model_revi.limitation: Monica-routed model review over three tiny-budget same-continuous smokes, including one no-valid Fairness failure; not independent human expert review.

online_same_run_paired_smoke_summary.limitation: three tiny-budget same-continuous smokes; valid benchmark aggregate favors autonomous or tie; Fairness row is no-valid; model review is not independent expert review

structured_feedback_probe.interpretation: Same-base-manuscript probe comparing informal feedback to IGRE-structured feedback. Measurement-readiness evidence only; not independent expert review or multi-task paper-quality evidence.

hypothesis_frontend_baseline_probe.interpretation: Front-end participation-mode evidence only; not downstream benchmark, paper-quality, or human expert evidence.

expert_review_taste_prior_probe.interpretation: Offline expert-review proxy for participation-mode selection; not live human co-pilot interaction data.

primary_reframing.claim: The main contribution is designing and empirically selecting human-participation modes that inject scientific taste and insight into automated research.
primary_reframing.new_evidence: OpenReview real review text is now used both to score participation modes and to guide 3 ML/AI mini-paper regenerations.

participation_mode_selection_probe.conservative_interpretation: structured_feedback_gate and claim_calibration_gate are the current top pair; the scorer output has a minor best_mode/ranking inconsistency, so do not claim a unique winner.
participation_mode_selection_probe.claim_boundary: Offline OpenReview-conditioned model-routed artifact scoring only.

openreview_guided_regeneration_probe.claim_boundary: Real OpenReview comments used as human taste/insight for mini-paper regeneration; no experiment rerun or independent expert review. The baseline win shows review text is not automatically beneficial.

review_insight_taxonomy_probe.claim_boundary: Taxonomy of actionable review signals; not causal proof of final paper improvement.

review_utility_map_probe.claim_boundary: Deterministic map from OpenReview comments to workflow-control signals; not causal proof of final paper improvement.

openreview_regeneration_cross_model_revi.claim_boundary: Cross-model review reduces same-model scoring bias for regenerated mini-paper artifacts, but it is still model-routed artifact review, not independent human peer review or experiment rerun.

focused_paper_quality_review.aggregate_conclusion: New gate-structure, gate-outcome, and single-gate artifact ablations strengthen IGRE's method distinctness and show that targeted gate routing can be more useful than full review context in a small OpenReview proxy. They do not close the top-conference evidence gap because independent human ratings, real benchmark gate reruns, and broader matched trajectories are still missing.
next_required_evidence: blind human expert ratings with inter-rater agreement
larger matched autonomous versus human-gated trajectories across tasks/seeds
real benchmark reruns where gate choices alter downstream experimental outcomes
narrower primary contribution narrative around participation-mode design
OpenReview taste/insight classifier validation against expert labels
scaled retrospective frontier-alignment study for delayed-value review signals

openreview_equal_context_ablation.claude_result: 3 review-guided wins, 0 context-control wins, 3 ties, mean delta +0.1667
openreview_equal_context_ablation.interpretation: Real paper-specific reviews show modest value beyond matched-length unrelated review context, especially for concrete method details and claim calibration.
openreview_equal_context_ablation.limitation: Model-routed scoring only; no independent human expert review and no experiment rerun.

summarizer_smoke.claim_boundary: Smoke test only; it uses the empty template and is not human evidence.

human_expert_blind_review_packet.interpretation: Evaluation readiness only; this does not satisfy independent human expert validation until completed score sheets are collected and summarized.

csv_validation.claim_boundary: Validation tooling only; no human ratings are collected.

preregistration.claim_boundary: Preregistration only; no independent human ratings have been collected.

human_expert_blind_review_packet.claim_boundary: Prepared preregistered blind review materials and collection tooling only; no independent human expert results are claimed.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.temporal_asymmetry_hypothesis: Short-term artifact quality can decrease while long-term frontier alignment increases.

smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic smoke test for the retrospective frontier-alignment protocol. Frontier descriptors are manually specified placeholders, not a citation-backed SOTA reconstruction. Use it as pipeline evidence, not as proof that historical reviewers predicted later research.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.claim_boundary: The smoke proves pipeline executability and records a negative heuristic result; it does not prove literature-backed future-frontier alignment.

citation_probe.citation_source: Semantic Scholar Graph API with OpenAlex fallback
citation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a lightweight citation-backed pilot using retrieved Semantic Scholar metadata and simple term-overlap scoring. It is stronger than manual descriptors but still not a full citation graph reconstruction, blinded expert review, or proof of long-term SOTA alignment. It filters citations by lexical relevance, but thin or topically broad citation graphs can still produce misleading frontier terms.

retrospective_frontier_citation_probe.claim_boundary: Expanded citation-backed lexical frontier matching still finds no delayed-value review cases; this supports protocol readiness and a negative boundary, not the delayed-value hypothesis.

clean_clone_reproducibility_audit.generated_file_drift_note: Rebuilding in the clean clone refreshed derived trace-dataset audit files and four PDFs; scripts completed successfully and all manifest artifacts exist, so this is a source-rebuild pass rather than a byte-for-byte generated-artifact immutability claim.
clean_clone_reproducibility_audit.note: Verifies the current pushed paper/skill/TFR package at dc8f35be with a shallow clean clone; shallow clone explains the one-entry commit index. Latest TFR probes remain negative for delayed-value evidence but are present, operationalized, and internally consistent.

live_skill_invocation_smoke.safe_claim: The process outlines a reusable workflow that is structured to refine and validate research outputs.
live_skill_invocation_smoke.claim_boundary: This live skill invocation smoke verifies that the reusable Codex skill can be applied to a fresh research task with real model calls and produces a task spec, five-gate IGRE plan, and audit. It is not a benchmark result, not independent human review, and not evidence that IGRE improves paper quality or performance.

skill_reuse_live_invocation.safe_claim: The process outlines a reusable workflow that is structured to refine and validate research outputs.
skill_reuse_live_invocation.claim_boundary: This live skill invocation smoke verifies that the reusable Codex skill can be applied to a fresh research task with real model calls and produces a task spec, five-gate IGRE plan, and audit. It is not a benchmark result, not independent human review, and not evidence that IGRE improves paper quality or performance.

metric_gaming_evaluator_stress_smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic evaluator-stress smoke linked to the live skill invocation. It demonstrates that a multi-metric guardrail can reject one synthetic metric-gaming candidate. It is not an FML-bench result, not a human-subject study, and not evidence that IGRE improves average benchmark performance.

fml_fairness_evaluator_stress_replay.claim_boundary: This is a replay over archived real FML-Bench Fairness_fairlearn evaluation artifacts. It supports evaluator-gate design against metric gaming, but it does not show a Fairness improvement, does not rerun the remote benchmark, and does not prove that IGRE improves average benchmark performance.

top_conference_empirical_support.reason: GPT weakly accepts, but Claude still weakly rejects because evidence remains thin, internally generated, mixed or negative for broad superiority, and lacks independent human expert evaluation.
next_required_evidence: blind human expert ratings with inter-rater agreement
larger matched autonomous versus human-gated trajectories across tasks/seeds
top_conference_empirical_support.gate_structure_ablation_status: routing-level ablation completed; downstream quality ablations still needed
top_conference_empirical_support.gate_outcome_attribution_status: post-hoc downstream attribution completed; causal single-gate artifact ablations still needed
top_conference_empirical_support.single_gate_artifact_ablation_status: small causal-style OpenReview proxy completed; independent human ratings and real benchmark reruns still needed

gate_structure_ablation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic routing ablation over archived OpenReview-derived review snippets. It supports the need for a multi-gate logging and routing structure, but it does not prove downstream paper-quality improvement, benchmark superiority, or independent human-review validity.

gate_outcome_attribution_probe.claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc attribution over six OpenReview regeneration pairs and model-review scores. It supports downstream gate-quality analysis as a design signal, but it does not prove causal improvement, independent human validity, or benchmark superiority.

single_gate_artifact_ablation.claim_boundary: This is a six-paper, model-reviewed OpenReview proxy using generated mini-paper artifacts. It is closer to a causal gate ablation than post-hoc attribution, but it does not replace independent human expert ratings, real benchmark reruns, or multi-task AI Scientist-v2 matched experiments.

review_frontier_signal_probe.claim_boundary: Review snippets contain routeable gates but do not outperform paper context under lexical citation-frontier scoring; stronger semantic and human-judged measures are required.

semantic_frontier_judge_probe.claim_boundary: Model-judged semantic matching addresses lexical limitations but still finds no delayed-value cases in the small sample; use as prioritization evidence, not proof.

temporal_frontier_replay_operational_spe.claim_boundary: TFR is operationalized and auditable, but the archived probes are negative for delayed-value human-review evidence. This supports a falsifiable protocol and a measurement boundary, not a positive long-horizon superiority claim.

high_tail_power_analysis.claim_boundary: This makes the high-tail claim falsifiable and gives sample-size requirements; it is not evidence that IGRE already increases rare breakthrough probability.

heldout_review_gate_validation.claim_boundary: Held-out validation reduces same-sample routing bias, but it is not independent human labeling and does not prove downstream quality gains.
